task.title: Relics: read a held conflict's bodies only when they are needed
task.description:
A relic is a record in Workbook beside tasks. It holds specs, plans, decisions and similar material as named parts, with the same history and sharing that tasks have.

This is a follow-up from the review of the first six relics stories (finding M63). It was left out of that work on purpose.

## Problem

Every command that opens a session reads the bodies of the relic conflicts a watcher holds (up to three bodies of 1 MiB for each conflict). Text mode reads bodies it never prints. This lasts until a `relic update` on that relic acknowledges the conflict.

## Wanted

Read the bodies only for a relic change on the relic the conflict names, or only for JSON output that carries them.

## Done when

- A task command with a held relic conflict reads no relic body.
- The conflict is still shown, and a relic change on that relic still gets the bodies.
